module_metadata.purpose: Assertions, Rich Logging, Performance Monitors, the 3-Step Headless CLI Workflow, and All 5 Headless Testing Guardrails.

headless_cli_three_step_workflow.critical_operational_rule: Always run `--headless --path <project_dir> --import` first on a fresh project so `.godot/global_script_class_cache.cfg` is generated before running `-s` unit test scripts!

critical_headless_testing_rules.rule: 1. NEVER Capture Local Primitives in Signal-Test Lambdas (GDScript Value-Capture Trap)
critical_headless_testing_rules.solution: Use `var probe: Dictionary[StringName, Variant] = {&"fired": false}` inside signal test lambdas so mutations persist by reference.
Defer the suite runner via `_run_suite.call_deferred()` in `_init()` and `await process_frame` after any method that uses `set_deferred()`.

critical_headless_testing_rules.rule: 3. Always Add Tested Nodes to `root` AND Populate All `@onready %UniqueNode` Children
critical_headless_testing_rules.solution: Never call `node._ready()` manually. Add to `root.add_child(node)` after attaching stub children with `child.owner = node` and `child.unique_name_in_owner = true`.

critical_headless_testing_rules.rule: 4. Physics Raycast Tests Require `await physics_frame` Before Calling `intersect_ray()`
critical_headless_testing_rules.solution: Wait two `await physics_frame` ticks after `root.add_child(collider)` so `PhysicsServer2D/3D` registers shapes in `direct_space_state`.

critical_headless_testing_rules.rule: 5. Pin Mouse-Aim Rotation (`player.set_process(false); player.rotation = 0.0`) Before Headless Raycast Tests
critical_headless_testing_rules.solution: In headless mode, `get_global_mouse_position()` defaults to `(0, 0)`. If a player script calls `look_at(get_global_mouse_position())` inside `_process()`, awaiting physics frames will rotate the player toward `(0, 0)` and make test raycasts miss! Disable `_process()` and set `player.rotation` explicitly before awaiting frames.
